items.t: Reflected in a dark window or a switched off television, the room behind them visible.
Through the gap in a stair banister.
From inside a cupboard someone has just opened.
A mirror selfie where nobody is looking at the mirror.
Dutch tilt, the whole room leaning, as if the photographer was also falling.
Extreme close up on hands only. Whose is whose is clear.
From across the street, through a lit ground floor window, evening.
Over one shoulder, the shoulder blurred, the others sharp.
Fish eye, a small room made enormous, feet in the corners.
Bird's eye from the light fitting, hair partings visible.
Security camera angle, corner of the ceiling, slight fish eye, time code absent.
Backs only. Three people and {4} watching something we cannot see.
